# truenas_snapshot_clone (Action)

Clones a snapshot into a new dataset (pool.snapshot.clone). The clone is a writable dataset sharing the snapshot's blocks until diverged.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_dst` (String) Full path of the new dataset to create as the clone, e.g. "tank/data-clone".
- `snapshot` (String) Snapshot to clone, e.g. "tank/data@snap1".
